headline: Trilegal, Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas act on AXISCADES acquiring 90% stake in Cloud Wave Technologies

detail: AXISCADES Technologies Limited has acquired 90% of the shareholding in Cloud Wave Technologies Private Limited, and its wholly owned subsidiaries, Aureate Polyment Private Limited and Protohubs System Solutions Private Limited. Trilegal advised AXISCADES on this transaction. The Firm conducted legal due diligence on Cloud Wave and its subsidiaries, and negotiated and drafted the share purchase agreement, shareholders' agreement, and other ancillary transaction documents. The transaction was led by Rahil Pereira (Partner), with support from Aishwaria Ramanan (Counsel), Mohammed Khalfan (Senior Associate) and Associates Shourya Pratap Singh Tomar, Gayatri Puthran, Dia Shetty, Shloka Prashant…
